messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT — Service: prod-inference-api
Alert: 502 spike (error_rate>5%)
Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345
Escalation policy: SRE-Pager (primary: oncall-sre, secondary: Samir Patel, manager: Lee Chen)

pagerduty-bot: Page dispatched to @oncall-sre (sms+push). No ack within 5m -> will escalate per policy.

Maya Liu: seeing 502s on /v1/generate from EU region, spike started ~08:12 UTC

Samir Patel: I'm secondary—getting page. @oncall-sre can you acknowledge? I'm going to look.

oncall-sre: (auto) no manual ack received; escalation in progress -> notifying secondary.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Secondary notified (Samir Patel) via SMS at 08:18 UTC

Samir Patel: acked via mobile (PD). jumping in now. quick triage: 502s from inference-gateway -> upstream 503 from model-runner pods.

Diana Ortiz: adding infra logs: 
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=model-runner
NAME                               READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
model-runner-5b8f6d6c4-2k9j9       0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   12         3h
model-runner-5b8f6d6c4-7t4xk       1/1     Running            0          2h
model-runner-5b8f6d6c4-9l3pq       0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   6          1h
```

Samir Patel: hunch: recent image rolled to model-runner maybe bad. checking deployment history.

Maya Liu: customer impact: synthetic monitoring shows 5% errors for production tenants; internal error id trace: org=acme-corp ~120 failed requests last 10m.

Samir Patel: rolling rollback to previous image and scaling up replicas temporarily.
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=registry.redwood/model-runner:v1.3.2
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/model-runner --replicas=6
```

pagerduty-bot: PD note: Manager escalation scheduled because primary missed first ack window; Manager (Lee Chen) notified at 08:22 UTC.

Lee Chen: on it — standby on bridge. tagging @support for customer comms.

Diana Ortiz: starting post-incident log collection and adding correlation ids.

Samir Patel: errors dropping to baseline over last 3 minutes, 502 rate down to 0.8% — continuing monitoring. opening temporary incident bridge: https://zoom.example/bridge/abcd

Maya Liu: creating incident doc stub: https://docs.redwood/inci/INC-2026-045

Samir Patel: plan: keep bridge open 30m, handoff to Diana (daylight oncall) at 08:50 UTC if stable. notify customers if error rate >1% persists.

Diana Ortiz: ack handoff plan. will loop in support to send advisory if needed.

Maya Liu: thanks — marking PD alert as acknowledged and silencing duplicates.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved (auto) — service prod-inference-api back to healthy. Closing thread when postmortem stub is updated. :white_check_mark:
